description: This file defines a Lightning JS component named 'Loader' that displays animated circles as a loading indicator, with configurable color and an alpha transition for fade-in and fade-out effects.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A Lightning JS component serving as a loading indicator with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an interval to toggle the alpha value between 0 and 1, creating a blinking effect for the loader.
